scenario: Create Payment incident: impact 5, urgency 5, 150 users
expected: 201; score 187; P1; ASSIGNED; SLA 3/20 minutes; audit and notifications
actual: JUnit: Payment score 187/P1; assignment; 3/20-minute SLA; four audit actions; reporter/assignee inbox notifications

scenario: Assigned technician acknowledges and starts work
expected: ACKNOWLEDGED then IN_PROGRESS; response clock stopped; audit events
actual: JUnit: acknowledgment timestamp retained on start; transition audit; no response violation after response deadline

scenario: Create, acknowledge, start, resolve, verify, close
expected: CLOSED/VERIFIED; one audit entry per transition
actual: JUnit and Postman: complete lifecycle; CLOSED/VERIFIED; exactly one audit per action

scenario: Change assignment strategy live from COMPOSITE to LOAD
expected: Next incidents assigned to the lowest-load eligible technician
actual: JUnit: live COMPOSITE to LOAD config change; two next assignments choose lower weighted load

scenario: Priority band boundary examples: 60,56,30,27,10,9
actual: JUnit PriorityEngineTest: all six specified score bands

scenario: Base 48 with users 9,10,100,101
actual: JUnit PriorityEngineTest: user counts 9/10/100/101

scenario: Weighted technician load 9 then 10 at capacity 10
actual: JUnit EligibilityFilterTest: load 9 accepted, load 10 excluded

scenario: Reopen at 6d23h59m then 7d1m after closing
actual: JUnit: reopen at 6d23h59m succeeds; 7d1m rejected; state/audit unchanged on rejection

scenario: Empty description, impact 6, affected users 0
actual: JUnit: all three invalid fields reported; no incident persisted

scenario: Upload executable and 6MB file
actual: HTTP: .exe and 6MB file rejected with 400; attachment list remains empty; valid text upload succeeds with 201

scenario: Close a NEW incident
expected: 409 INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION; no close audit; state unchanged
actual: JUnit: NEW cannot close; 409; no state/audit mutation

scenario: Resolve IN_PROGRESS without notes
actual: JUnit: empty resolution notes rejected; IN_PROGRESS retained; no RESOLVED audit

scenario: Set all matching technicians OFF_DUTY; create incident
expected: CLASSIFIED triage; TRIAGE_NEEDED notification; no reporter error
actual: JUnit: all matching technicians OFF_DUTY; CLASSIFIED/null assignee; lead receives TRIAGE_NEEDED

scenario: Create incident with missing service 99999
actual: JUnit and Postman: missing service returns 404 SERVICE_NOT_FOUND

scenario: Remove matching service/global P4 policies and create P4 incident
actual: JUnit: no global/service P4 SLA returns 422; no incident persisted

scenario: Report seeded VPN near duplicate then confirmNotDuplicate
expected: 409 DUPLICATE_INCIDENT then 201; threshold per implemented engine
actual: HTTP: seeded VPN near-duplicate returns 409 DUPLICATE_INCIDENT; confirmNotDuplicate submission returns 201

scenario: Employee requests admin users and config write
actual: JUnit: admin users GET/config PUT both denied; two ACCESS_DENIED audit entries; config unchanged

scenario: Other technician acknowledges assigned incident
actual: JUnit: unrelated technician denied acknowledgment; no state/audit mutation

scenario: Expired access token, rotation, revoked token, logout
expected: TOKEN_EXPIRED; rotation succeeds; revoked/logout refreshes rejected
actual: JUnit: expiry; refresh rotation; reused refresh revokes sessions; logout rejects refresh

scenario: Five wrong passwords; correct password; advance clock 15m
expected: 401 then 423 ACCOUNT_LOCKED; after timeout login succeeds
actual: JUnit: generic unknown-email/wrong-password message; five failures; 15-minute lock; successful login after expiry

scenario: Request info, advance test clock 20m, provide info
expected: Paused SLA; resolution deadline moved exactly 20m; IN_PROGRESS
actual: JUnit: real request/provide-info APIs with exact 20-minute clock advance; due shifted 1200 seconds; pause cleared

scenario: Unacknowledged P1; advance through escalation then acknowledge
expected: Levels 1,2,3 with audit/notification; stops on acknowledge
actual: JUnit: levels 1/2/3 each audit and notify correct holder once; repeated monitor harmless; acknowledgment stops escalation

scenario: SLA monitor twice each at 75,90,100 percent
expected: One first warning, second warning, violation; no duplicates
actual: JUnit: monitor repeated at 75/90/100 percent; two warning audits; one resolution violation and violation audit

scenario: Two simultaneous incident updates with same version
actual: JUnit: concurrent equal-version edits produce one 200 and one 409; winner persisted; version increments once

scenario: Karthik reports Networking incident; assign him manually
actual: JUnit: reporter excluded from automatic assignment; manual assignment rejected with CONFLICT_OF_INTEREST

scenario: Karthik queue, create incident, admin user list
